notes.title: 1.3.0 Update
notes.content:
Update 1.3.0 has just come to Battle of Finland: Winter War, lots of new content added and +60 FPS mode.

Added +60 FPS mode to game launch options. Game now runs above 60FPS if your screen support above 60hz. +60 FPS mode is still in beta and may cause problems in the game. +60FPS mode is only available for Windows and macOS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41935491/153f8c11734a3f75bace105a39b7230bc4128d5c.png[/img]

[h3]New content[/h3]

[list]
[*] 10 Master Levels and 2 new levels (now game has 50 levels)
[*] Added new 10 tier battlepass (now game has tier 60 battlepass)
[*] Two new player skins
[*] Three new weapon skins
[*] Tank and Plane skins
[*] Five new achievements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41935491/3c4a39a47790c26bd732b89c17f4015b2ad67524.png[/img]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

Fix reload visual bug
Railway shooting tweaks
Fix if select mouse/controller in main menu it not save when load game
Settings menu hud size select bug fix when using controller
Intro text not showing when using controller
When delete save levels not reset to 0
Fixed graphical glitch when running game at 1080p resolution

[previewyoutube=isLNoJAEJg4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
Update 1.2.0 has just come to Battle of Finland: Winter War, controller support and Linux version.

[h1]Controller support added[/h1]

[h1]Linux version added[/h1]

[h3]Bugs fixes and more ...[/h3]

Final level difficulty tweaking (easier)
Menu navigation made more controller friendly

[b]Fixes[/b]
DLC Settings launguage
Settings were not saved correctly
DLC skie level anti-arcraft gun
DLC battlepass content was already unlocked

notes.title: 1.1.2 Update
notes.content:
Small update 1.1.2

- Fix hard difficult tutorial level checkpoint text (removed)
- Fix DLC Intro level music (if music off not play music anymore)

notes.title: 1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Update 1.1.1 has just come to Battle of Finland: Winter War, DLC size free update.

[list]
[*] New overworld
[*] 10 new levels
[*] 10 extra levels to BattlePass
[*] New anti aircraft gun with 4 skins
[*] 2 new player skins
[*] Two new enemys, Tank and Plane
[*] 6 new achievement
[*] New Super Easy Difficult (great for game journalist), start with Suomi KP/31 already unlock
[*] And bug fixes
[/list]

[previewyoutube=znb2jLMhqLE;full][/previewyoutube]
